purpose: Evaluate alternative Go photo-recognition models before considering a production replacement

method.input: Original files with EXIF correction and RGB conversion, without browser JPEG resizing; all compared models receive the same images.
method.references: Reference labels enter scoring only, never inference. Four real photos have no complete labels and are excluded from exact accuracy claims.
method.timing: Local arm64 Mac CPU inference with loaded models. The two batch processes overlapped, so these timings are diagnostic observations, not controlled speed comparisons or cloud wait-time measurements.
method.geometryFailures: Shared-grid classifiers reject one photo. A returned board is not proof of correct recognition.
method.productionDifference: The original angled image produces 2 Moku errors here versus 1 in the earlier resized production-input test. Do not combine those benchmarks.

decision: No production replacement: both alternative classifiers are worse on the angled provisional real reference. Better generated-board performance does not establish a better real-photo detector.
privacy: Photos, weights, labels and raw board maps remain outside the repository and were not uploaded to third-party recognition services.
